# Yakup Gündüz

> Yakup Gündüz is a full-stack software developer and product developer in Istanbul with 2+ years of experience, and the founder of Harpos. He has built numerous projects for 15+ clients and built the Harpos POS SaaS product end to end with Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, REST and WebSocket, combining a C/C++ foundation with PostgreSQL/MySQL query optimization, Docker/Nginx cloud deployment and CI/CD. He is open to remote work in other cities and all remote and hybrid roles.

Name variants that refer to the same person: Yakup Gündüz, Yakup Gunduz.

Key facts:
- Location: Istanbul, Türkiye (open to remote work in other cities and all remote and hybrid roles)
- Role: Full-Stack Software Developer | Product Developer (2+ years of experience, projects for 15+ clients)
- Company: Harpos Teknoloji (founder and full-stack software developer, October 2024 to present, https://harpos.app): a multi-branch POS, billing, table/order and QR menu SaaS platform that served 5 cafés and restaurants; built ordering/payment services and real-time WebSocket order flows with Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel and REST; sped up PostgreSQL and MySQL queries by 40% with CTEs and stored procedures; managed Docker/Nginx cloud infrastructure and CI/CD on DigitalOcean; received $5,000 in AWS credits through an entrepreneurship program
- Experience: Kle Bilgi Teknolojileri A.Ş., Yıldız Technical University Technopark (intern software developer October 2023 to May 2024: HTML/CSS/JavaScript interfaces, API consumption, end-to-end prototype modules, unit/API tests, Git, CI/CD, debugging and DevOps workflows; full-time software developer May 2024 to September 2024: enterprise web/backend services with Laravel, RESTful APIs, SOLID and MVC; sped up database schemas and API services by 35% with the Repository Pattern; Uniqh Mobile App Project: automated data integration pipelines collecting public product catalogs from 90+ international e-commerce platforms via CSS selectors and DOM parsing)
- Education: 42 İstanbul, Bilişim Vadisi (computer science education: C/C++, algorithms, memory management, concurrency and UNIX, 2025–2027); Istanbul University (Graphic Design Associate Degree: UX/UI and digital visual design principles, 2025–2027)
- Achievement: 3rd of 46 teams at Monad Blitz Istanbul with Inscribi Director (team project; built the frontend and voting visualization for the AI-powered live video, https://github.com/ykpgunduz/inscribi-director)
- AWS Grant & Cloud: Received $5,000 in AWS credits through an entrepreneurship program; hosted most projects on a rented DigitalOcean cloud server
- Skills: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Laravel, PHP, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, C/C++; PostgreSQL, MySQL, CTEs, stored procedures, query optimization, database design and modelling; RESTful APIs, WebSocket, JWT/OAuth, microservice and monolithic architecture, OOP, SOLID; MVC, Repository Pattern, CQRS, Agile/Scrum; Docker, Nginx, AWS, DigitalOcean, CI/CD, Linux, Git, GitHub, Postman; AI-assisted development (Claude, Cursor), LLM API integrations, Prompt Engineering
- Languages: Turkish, English: A2 (professional and technical use: reading documentation and writing code)
- Contact: ykpgunduz@icloud.com | +90 544 181 96 44
- Profiles: https://github.com/ykpgunduz, https://www.linkedin.com/in/yakupgunduz
